minutes.headline: Select Board backs a road debt exclusion question; ballot wording to be voted next week
minutes.summary: The board heard the pavement management plan and a proposal for a one-time debt exclusion for local roads, paired with a written policy to fund road maintenance in the operating budget. The town manager then reviewed the draft annual town meeting warrant articles, followed by a teen center parking concern and committee reports.

what_happened.line: The Select Board heard a proposal for a one-time debt exclusion for local roads, paid over seven years, and members voiced support.
The town manager also proposed a written financial policy to raise the road line in the operating budget each year using motor vehicle excise growth.
The board was told the town spends well under what the pavement management plan says roads need each year.
No vote was taken; the ballot question is to come back with drafted wording next week for a vote.
The town manager reviewed the draft annual town meeting warrant and is to set up a meeting with the teen center about parking.

why_it_matters: A road debt exclusion would add a temporary, voter-approved charge to property tax bills for seven years, so residents would be asked to vote on it at the ballot.
The proposed policy would shape how much of future road upkeep is paid from the operating budget, which is mostly taxes, instead of by borrowing.
